description: Return a list of all Forms from a specified Project.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

parameters.name: filters[form_template_id]
parameters.description: Array of Form Template IDs. Return item(s) associated with the specified Form Template IDs.

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) matching the specified search query string.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]

id.description: Unique identifier of the Form. Use as the `{id}` path parameter for show, update, delete, and send_email requests on this Form.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Form was created, in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Free-text description of the Form provided by its author.

form_template_id.description: ID of the Form Template this Form was created from. References a Form Template in the same company.

form_template_name.description: Name of the Form Template this Form was created from.

private.description: When true, the Form is visible only to its creator and users with admin access to the Forms tool; when false, it is visible to all users who can view Forms.

created_by.description: The user who created the Form.

id.description: ID of the user (login information) who created the Form.

login.description: Email/login of the user who created the Form.

name.description: Full name of the user who created the Form.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Form was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

fillable_pdf.description: The fillable PDF file backing this Form.

id.description: ID of the underlying file (Prostore File) for the fillable PDF.

url.description: Download URL for the fillable PDF.

filename.description: Original filename of the fillable PDF.

name.description: Display name of the fillable PDF file.

can_be_viewed.description: True when the current user is permitted to view this file.

viewable.description: True when a viewable (rendered) version of the PDF has been generated and can be displayed in-app.

attachments.description: Additional files attached to the Form.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the Form's thumbnail image. Falls back to a generic document placeholder image when no thumbnail has been generated.

viewable.description: True when a viewable (rendered) version of the Form's fillable PDF exists and can be displayed in-app.

viewable_document_id.description: ID of the generated viewable document for the Form's fillable PDF. Null when no viewable version has been generated.

holder_class.description: Class name of the record that holds the file, used by attachment-related clients. Always "Form" for this resource.

download_all_uuid.description: Session token object used to request a bulk download of the Form and its attachments. Only populated on the show response; null otherwise.

attachment.description: The Form's primary fillable PDF, exposed as a single attachment object. Mirrors `fillable_pdf`.

id.description: ID of the attachment file (Prostore File).

can_be_viewed.description: True when the current user is permitted to view this attachment.

viewable.description: True when a viewable (rendered) version of the attachment has been generated and can be displayed in-app.

permissions.description: The current user's permissions for this Form. Only present when the request includes the `view=with_permissions` query parameter.

can_edit.description: True when the current user can edit this Form.

can_view_change_history.description: True when the current user can view this Form's change history.

can_view_download_log.description: True when the current user can view this Form's download log.

can_email.description: True when the current user can send this Form by email.

can_destroy.description: True when the current user can delete this Form.

deleted.description: True when the Form has been soft-deleted (moved to the recycle bin) and is pending permanent removal or restoration.
